mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_capability_report(project_id,assignment_id,user_id,report_version,status,knowledge_snapshot_id,path_version, facts_json,dimensions_json,overall_decision,current_task_id) VALUES(#{projectId},#{assignmentId},#{userId},#{reportVersion},'PROCESSING',#{knowledgeSnapshotId},#{pathVersion}, CAST(#{factsJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{dimensionsJson} AS JSON),#{overallDecision},#{currentTaskId})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(report_version),0)+1 FROM sa_capability_report WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId}
SELECT * FROM sa_capability_report WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} ORDER BY report_version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM sa_capability_report WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_capability_report SET status='FAILED',error_message=#{errorMessage},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE sa_capability_report SET status='READY',ai_summary=#{summary}, dimensions_json=JSON_SET(dimensions_json,'$.strengths',CAST(#{strengths} AS JSON)), risks_json=CAST(#{risks} AS JSON),recommended_sources_json=CAST(#{sources} AS JSON), model_name=#{modelName},generated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,error_message=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND current_task_id=#{taskId} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE sa_capability_report SET status='FAILED',error_message='能力报告生成失败，请重新发起',update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND current_task_id=#{taskId} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE sa_capability_report SET status='FAILED',error_message=#{errorMessage},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND update_time<TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,-#{timeoutSeconds},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY update_time,id LIMIT #{batchSize}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id assignmentId,a.project_id projectId,a.assignee_user_id userId,a.path_id pathId,a.path_version pathVersion, a.knowledge_snapshot_id knowledgeSnapshotId,a.status decisionStatus,a.progress,a.submitted_at submittedAt,a.due_at dueAt, p.name pathName,p.target_role targetRole,p.description pathDescription FROM sa_onboarding_assignment a JOIN sa_onboarding_path p ON p.id=a.path_id WHERE a.id=#{assignmentId}

SELECT a.id assignmentId,a.project_id projectId,a.assignee_user_id userId,a.path_id pathId,a.path_version pathVersion, a.knowledge_snapshot_id knowledgeSnapshotId,a.status decisionStatus,a.progress,a.submitted_at submittedAt,a.due_at dueAt, p.name pathName,p.target_role targetRole,p.description pathDescription FROM sa_onboarding_assignment a JOIN sa_onboarding_path p ON p.id=a.path_id WHERE a.id=#{assignmentId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id taskId,type,title,resource_type resourceType,resource_id resourceId, prerequisite_task_ids_json dependencies,required,status,completion_note completionNote,completed_at completedAt FROM sa_onboarding_assignment_task WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} ORDER BY sort_order,id

SELECT qa.id attemptId,qa.quiz_id quizId,qa.status,qa.auto_score autoScore,qa.final_score finalScore,qa.review_required reviewRequired, q.title,qa.rubric_version rubricVersion,qa.user_id userId,COUNT(ans.id) answerCount, SUM(CASE WHEN qq.type<>'SHORT' AND ans.is_correct=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wrongCount, SUM(CASE WHEN qq.type='SHORT' AND ans.final_score<qq.max_score*0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) shortLowCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ans.scoring_source='AI_SUGGESTION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) aiSuggestedCount FROM sa_quiz_attempt qa JOIN sa_quiz q ON q.id=qa.quiz_id LEFT JOIN sa_quiz_answer ans ON ans.attempt_id=qa.id LEFT JOIN sa_quiz_question qq ON qq.id=ans.question_id WHERE qa.status IN ('REVIEW_PENDING','COMPLETED') AND qa.project_id=(SELECT project_id FROM sa_onboarding_assignment WHERE id=#{assignmentId}) AND (qa.assignment_task_id IN (SELECT id FROM sa_onboarding_assignment_task WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sa_onboarding_assignment_task t WHERE t.assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND t.quiz_attempt_id=qa.id)) GROUP BY qa.id

SELECT r.id runId,r.scenario_id scenarioId,r.status,r.program_score programScore,r.final_score finalScore,r.pass_candidate passCandidate, r.rubric_version rubricVersion,r.user_id userId,s.name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.risk_flag=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) riskyActions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_drill_rule rule WHERE rule.scenario_id=s.id AND rule.rule_type IN ('REQUIRED','VALIDATION') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sa_drill_run_action x WHERE x.run_id=r.id AND x.matched_rule_id=rule.id)) missingRequiredActions FROM sa_drill_run r JOIN sa_drill_scenario s ON s.id=r.scenario_id LEFT JOIN sa_drill_run_action a ON a.run_id=r.id WHERE r.status IN ('REVIEW_PENDING','COMPLETED') AND r.project_id=(SELECT project_id FROM sa_onboarding_assignment WHERE id=#{assignmentId}) AND (r.assignment_task_id IN (SELECT id FROM sa_onboarding_assignment_task WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sa_onboarding_assignment_task t WHERE t.assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND t.drill_run_id=r.id)) GROUP BY r.id

SELECT target_type targetType,target_id targetId,decision,score_override scoreOverride,comment,reviewer_id reviewerId,create_time createTime FROM sa_assessment_review WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND (target_type='ASSIGNMENT' AND target_id=#{assignmentId} OR target_type='QUIZ_ATTEMPT' AND (target_id IN (SELECT quiz_attempt_id FROM sa_onboarding_assignment_task WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId}) OR target_id IN (SELECT id FROM sa_quiz_attempt WHERE assignment_task_id IN (SELECT id FROM sa_onboarding_assignment_task WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId}))) OR target_type='DRILL_RUN' AND (target_id IN (SELECT drill_run_id FROM sa_onboarding_assignment_task WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId}) OR target_id IN (SELECT id FROM sa_drill_run WHERE assignment_task_id IN (SELECT id FROM sa_onboarding_assignment_task WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId})))) ORDER BY id

SELECT v.id documentVersionId,d.title title FROM sa_knowledge_snapshot_item i JOIN sa_document_version v ON v.id=i.document_version_id JOIN sa_document d ON d.id=v.document_id WHERE i.snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} ORDER BY i.id
